Dynamism is recruiting founding and early-career engineers for partner startups, including teams building AI-native and infrastructure-heavy products. The roles involve owning major systems, shaping architecture and product direction, and shipping quickly in close collaboration with founders and users.
Computer Software

Responsibilities
You'll own major systems — from backend infra to onboarding flows
You'll help shape early architecture, engineering standards, and product roadmap
You'll work directly with the founders — often as hire #1 or #2
You'll ship quickly, talk to users, and iterate based on real feedback
You'll be solving high-value, technically challenging problems in small, fast teams

Are a recent CS/engineering graduate or have equivalent practical experience, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering

Show high agency, move fast in ambiguity, and default to ownership over direction
Use LLM tooling like GPT or Claude to work faster and smarter
Have shipped internships, substantial projects, or open-source contributions that demonstrate ownership and the ability to learn quickly
Care deeply about product and want your work to touch real users

Built product-adjacent features like billing, auth, analytics, data infra, or multiplayer
Explored infra, AI/ML, devtools, eComm, or SaaS through internships or projects
Collaborated on a team or shipped independently at a high bar
Built side projects that users actually adopted
